Titles.jpn: ひみつのアイプリ

Summaries.eng: Himitsu no Aipri is the title of the next anime in the Pretty series. Himari and Mitsuki are close friends and new students at Paradise Private Academy. Despite their friendship, both have a secret that they are withholding from one another (fittingly, the word “Himitsu” in the show’s title means “secret”).
Summaries.jpn: ひみつのあいプリはプリティーシリーズの次回アニメのタイトルです。ひまりとミツキは親友で、私立パラダイス学園の新入生です。友情にもかかわらず、二人はお互いに隠している秘密を持っています（番組タイトルの「秘密」という言葉は「秘密」を意味するのにふさわしくありません）。

Summaries.eng:
The main characters, Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, enter Paradise Private Academy. Himari, who aspires for AIPRI, dreams of making 10,000 friends! But for the shy and anxious Himari, it might be a bit difficult.......

Himari unexpectedly makes her AIPRI debut!?

She has a "secret" she can't even tell her best friend, Mitsuki! But it seems that Mitsuki has a "secret" of her own.......

Secret-bearers Himari and Mitsuki's AIPRI begins!!
Summaries.jpn:
私立しりつパラダイス学園がくえんに入学にゅうがくした主人公しゅじんこう
青空(あおぞら)ひまり と 星川(ほしかわ)みつき 。

アイプリに憧あこがれるひまりの夢ゆめは、
おともだちを1万人いちまんにんつくること!

でも人見知りひとみしでキンチョーしぃのひまりには、
ちょっとむずかしいかも……。

そんなひまりが思おもいがけず アイプリデビュー することに!?

親友しんゆうのみつきにも言いえない
『ひみつ』ができちゃった!

だけど、みつきにもなにやら
『ひみつ』があるようで…… 。
Summaries.pt:
As personagens principais, Himari Aozora e Mitsuki Hoshikawa, entram na Academia Particular Paradise. Himari, que quer ser uma AiPri, sonha em fazer 10.000 amigos! Mas para a tímida e ansiosa Himari, pode ser um pouco difícil...

Himari inesperadamente faz sua estreia no AiPri!?

Ela tem um "segredo" que não consegue contar nem para sua melhor amiga, Mitsuki! Mas parece que Mitsuki também tem um "segredo"...

O AIPRI das portadoras do segredo, Himari e Mitsuki, começa!!

Titles.jpn: ひまりのアイプリデビュー!

Summaries.eng: Himari Aozora enters the private Paradise Academy with her best friend Mitsuki Hoshikawa. Her dream is to make 10,000 friends! Himari longs to be an idol princess — an Aipri who sings and dances like Mi-chan, but it might be a little difficult for the shy and anxious Himari. However, she manages to make it through the entrance ceremony thanks to Mitsuki's secret good luck charm. On her way back to the dormitory, exhausted, Himari discovers a mysterious door in the student council room. What awaits her is the Aipri Verse, a place where Aipri sing and dance!

Titles.jpn: みつきのひみつの約束

Summaries.eng: Himari has successfully made her debut as an Aipri. However, she realizes that she broke her promise to Mitsuki that they would "debut together" when she was little. On the other hand, Mitsuki, who debuted as the Aipri Mi-chan, is also heartbroken that she broke her promise to Himari. Himari wants to sincerely apologize to Mitsuki, but is warned by the student council that produces Himari that it is a "secret" that she must not tell anyone. Mitsuki also couldn't bring herself to tell Himari. The relationship between the two, who have a "secret," gradually becomes strained...

Titles.jpn: 生徒会のひみつのレッスン
ドキドキ!初めての参観日
ピカピカ☆おそうじ対決
挑戦！アイプリグランプリ

Summaries.eng: The super popular duos Ruby=Lazuli and AISMIRIN announce that they will hold the 1st AiPri Grand Prix, a competition where the idols compete in singing and dancing. Himari and Mitsuki decide to compete as solo artists. Sakura trains hard with the aim of winning the competition alongside Tamaki. However, Tamaki realizes that Sakura's true purpose is not to win the Grand Prix, but something else...

Titles.jpn: ヴィクトリアのひみつ

Summaries.eng: All students at Paradise School are banned from using AiPri by Principal Victoria. Himari, who broadcast on AiPri after lights-out time, was feeling guilty about this. The student council president, Sakura, goes to Victoria to try to revoke the ban. Victoria says she will allow you to use AiPri if she can show you how wonderful AiPri is. Then, Sakura tells Himari and Mitsuki to form a duo and perform an incredible live show. Will the two be able to perform a live that convinces Victoria?

Titles.jpn: クラスメイトのひみつ

Summaries.eng: An adorable drawing of Himari and Mitsuki was very popular on SNS “AiPrigram”. In the class, everyone is excited about the artist “Yuko Sai”, who made the drawing. Meanwhile, Himari and her classmate Hanazono Yuko are chosen to be part of the class newspaper committee. Himari wants to become friends with Hanazono, but she is very shy and it is not easy to get close to her. At one point, Himari ends up accidentally seeing a drawing made by Hanazono.

Titles.jpn: 結成！アイプリ探偵団

Summaries.eng: On her channel, Chii searches for a ghost rumored to appear in the world of AiPri, the “AiPriVerse”. Mitsuki passes out after watching the broadcast because she is very afraid of ghosts. Himari decides to go to AiPriVerse to capture the ghost. However, she ends up revealing to Mamiya Chii, a classmate passing by, that she is an AiPri. Himari also discovers that her classmate is actually Chii from AiPri. Himari and Chii decide to form the AiPri Detective Team to investigate the ghost's true identity.

Titles.jpn: みつきのライバル登場！

Summaries.eng: Mitsuki has been feeling a little lonely lately seeing Himari spending so much time with Suzukaze Tsumugi. Meanwhile, the student council investigates Tsumugi, who has launched a new system called “Bazzlume Change”, which is activated when the audience's enthusiasm reaches its limit. To test her abilities, Sakura asks Mitsuki to face Tsumugi in a Duel Test. However, Mitsuki is worried that if she loses, Himari will be taken from her, so she announces that she wants to stop participating in the Duel Test.

Titles.eng: Kitty Cat! The Secret Search Operation!
Titles.jpn: ねこねこ！ひみつの大捜索

Summaries.eng: The Nyan Nyan Festival is an event where AiPri gather dressed in cat clothes. On the day of the event, Mii-chan's channel receives a comment from a cat owner asking for help finding her lost cat. Himari and Mitsuki start looking for the kitten. During the search, they find Yuuma acting suspiciously. Yuuma was secretly taking care of a cat that had entered the school, but when he realized that this cat is the same one mentioned on Mii-chan's channel...

Titles.jpn: アイプリバースのひみつ

Summaries.eng: Final exams are coming up, Himari and Mitsuki are dedicating themselves to their studies. Meanwhile, in AiPri Verse, many of the Aimu, including MC Aimu, are talking to each other. Himari's Aimu returns from maintenance and reports what has happened to Himari so far: her debut, her secret with Mitsuki, the meeting with Tsumugi, the competition against the super duo Ruby=Lazuli, the ban on AiPri by director Victoria , the duo of Himari and Mitsuki…Aimu and the others remember the different memories of AiPri that Himari experienced.

Titles.jpn: 情熱のグランプリコーデ

Summaries.eng: AiPri stars Ruby=Lazuli will perform wearing the Rose Grand Prix Coord, which they won at the 1st AiPri Grand Prix. Himari and Mitsuki are very excited about this, but Tamaki Nikaido, one of the members of Ruby=Lazuli, is worried. On the day of the show, Sakura and Tamaki excitedly go to AiPri to perform, but they are unable to go on stage and the show is cancelled. The two are told by the Rose Grand Prix Coord: “You can’t dress me like you are now.”

Titles.jpn: とどけ! ひみつのライブ

Summaries.eng: Himari hasn't been seen at AiPri for over 10 days, she lost all confidence in herself after seeing Ruby=Lazuli's performance. During this time, Himari feels as if Mugi-chan, the Pri-Usa, is talking to her. Thus, Himari enters the dream world and meets Tsumugi. Tsumugi tells Himari that she forgot how to smile. Himari then realizes that she can't remember how she used to smile. When Mitsuki finds out, she asks Himari's brother Hinata and her own brother Yakumo for advice.

Titles.eng: Aim for It! A Grand Prix Victory
Titles.jpn: めざせ！グランプリ優勝

Summaries.eng: AiPri stars Ruby=Lazuli announce that the “2nd AiPri Grand Prix” will be held. Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa decide to participate as a pair and promise to win, to achieve this they begin to train hard. However, one day, Himari ends up sleeping too much. Mitsuki, who had planned the special training, is angry because Himari ruined everything. In the end, Mitsuki gets angry with Himari because she doesn't apologize and doesn't think she did anything wrong. Himari responds by saying, “You don’t need to be so mad!” and, before the Grand Prix, the two end up fighting.
Summaries.jpn: スターアイプリのルビー＝ラズリから、第２回アイプリグランプリが開かれることが宣言される。ひまりとみつきはデュオで出場し、優勝することを誓う。そのために、猛特訓にはげむ二人。しかし、ある日、ひまりは寝坊をしてしまう。特訓の計画を立てていたみつきは、台無しになってしまったことに怒り気味。悪気がなく、謝ってくれないひまりに、とうとう怒ってしまうみつき。そんなに怒んなくてもいいのに！と言い返すひまり。グランプリを前に、二人はケンカをしてしまい……。

Titles.jpn: ひまりとみつきとつむぎ

Summaries.eng: During the 2nd AiPri Grand Prix, Mitsuki tells Himari that their duo is breaking up. When Tsumugi finds out that the two had a fight, she goes to talk to Mitsuki to try to reconcile them. Mitsuki says, “There are times when Himari is so selfish that I can't deal with her,” but decides to face her properly and apologize. Tsumugi goes to see Himari to tell her about Mitsuki's feelings. Tsumugi intends to reconcile their friendship, but ends up saying that Mitsuki said: “Himari is selfish”. As a result, the relationship between Himari and Mitsuki worsens even further. Will the two be able to reconcile before the live performance?

Titles.jpn: アイスマイリンのひみつ

Summaries.eng: Lately, the AISMIRIN duo of Airi Mitsuba and Rinrin Shinomiya haven't been doing any shows. As their popularity is declining, the two decide that their next performance will be their “last show”. Although the group still has the PriFriends' attention, Airi wants to retire the unit while it is still popular. When Sakura Ichijouji and Tamaki Nikaidou discover this, they tease the two by saying, “It's a shame. We’ve never seen you guys do a Bazzlume Change.” Feeling frustrated, Airi and Rinrin begin training, but are unable to perform the Buzzlume Change. They realize that if it continues like this, the chance of them saying goodbye successfully is practically nil.

Titles.jpn: ひまりの卒業試験

Summaries.eng: On the last day of the first semester, Himari is called by the student council and is told that “it is time to graduate from student council production.” However, this depends on her passing the final exam. Himari is allowed to take the test with Mitsuki and Tsumugi, but to pass, they need to give an even more incredible performance than the one at the 2nd AiPri Grand Prix. The three think about what type of presentation to do and decide on the name of the group.

Titles.jpn: さがせ！人魚の星くず

Summaries.eng: Summer vacation is finally here. In her dream, Aozora Himari encounters the Mermaid Grand Prix outfit that she received as the grand prize outfit at the 2nd Aipri Grand Prix. She is then given the challenge of finding the mysterious treasure, "Mermaid Stardust," that lies dormant in the sea if she wants to wear it. After that, Himari goes on a family trip to a villa near the sea. It turns out to be the villa of Mitsuki Hoshikawa's grandparents, and Mitsuki is also there. While enjoying their summer fun, Himari finds out that Mitsuki had the same dream, so she invites Tsumugi Suzukaze and the three of them go looking for the "Mermaid Stardust" that lies dormant in the sea of ​​Aipriverse. What is the true identity of the mysterious treasure?
Summaries.jpn: いよいよ夏休み。ひまりは夢の中で、第２回アイプリグランプリのグランプリコーデとしてもらったマーメイドグランプリコーデと出会う。そして、「私を着たいなら、海に眠る幻の秘宝『人魚の星屑』を見つけ出しなさい」という試練を与えられる。その後、家族旅行で海の近くの別荘にやってきたひまり。そこは何とみつきのおじいちゃん・おばあちゃんの別荘で、みつきもいた。夏の遊びを満喫する中、みつきも同じ夢を見ていたと知ったひまりは、つむぎも誘い、３人でアイプリバースの海に眠る『人魚の星屑』を探しに行く。果たして、幻の秘宝の正体とは……？

Titles.jpn: ひまりのひみつ

Summaries.eng: Himari is having a great time at her villa during summer vacation. However, it seems that everyone, including her family and Mitsuki, are keeping some kind of "secret" from her. Himari also wants to tell her family her "secret" - that she is Himari from Ai-Pri. Meanwhile, when Himari sees Mitsuki talking to her grandmother about Ai-Pri, she feels envious. She also wants to tell her family, but for some reason she is interrupted and cannot. So Himari decides to reveal her feelings at an Ai-Pri Live.=
Summaries.jpn: 夏休み、別荘で楽しく過こしているひまり。でも家族やみ つきなどみんなが、何やらひまりに「ひみつ」にしているこ とがあるようだ。ひまりも家族に「ひみつ」を打ち明けたい と思っていた。それは、自分はアイブリのひまりだという こと‘、そんななか、みつきがおばあちゃんにアイプリの話 をしているのを見たひまリは、うらやましく思う。自分も 家族に打ち明けようとするが、なぜか邪魔が入って言えな い。そこでひまりは、自分の思いをアイブリライブで打ち 明けようと思い立つ。

Titles.eng: Secret Deserted Island / Aipri Summer Festival
Titles.jpn: ひみつの無人島/アイプリサマーフェス

Summaries.eng: Himari and Mitsuki are still enjoying their summer vacation. But when they wake up, they are shocked to find that they, along with their classmate Mamiya Chii, are on a deserted island! There are huge dinosaur-like footprints on the ground. Are these the footprints of a giant creature that was supposed to be extinct...? Will the three be able to escape the island safely? Meanwhile, Mitsuba Airi of the student council is planning to hold an Airi-Pri music festival to make the last memories of summer vacation.
Summaries.jpn: まだまだ夏休みを満喫中のひまりとみつき。しかし目を覚 まL1てピックリ1 なんと、ひま1）とみつき、そして、5、たり のクラスメイト・真実夜（まみや）チィは無人島にいた― 地面には恐竜のような巨大な足あとがある。これは、絶滅 したはずの巨大生物の足あとなのか……？はたして3人 ！ま、無．に島から脱出できるのかワー方、生徒会の三ツ 葉（みつば）アイリは、休み最後の思い出を作るぺく、アイ プリ音楽フェスティバルを開こうと考えていた。

Summaries.eng:
A new semester has begun! Mitsuki Hoshikawa and Himari Aozora are now in their 2nd year at Paradise Private Academy! With the arrival of new students full of unique personalities, life at school promises to be more exciting than ever.

In AiPri Verse, new AiPris continue to appear! Let's all experience a new and surprising Buzzlume Change (the Jewel Buzzlume Change)!

But then, a mysterious princess named Ring Clover and her butler, Shitsumu, announce that an “AiPri Grand Prix” will be held!

Himari and Mitsuki are excited after hearing that if they win, they will become the long-awaited “Eternal AiPris.”

But… it seems that Princess Ring is hiding a big secret…

A journey that will expand the bonds of friendship and secrets, the long-awaited “Ring-hen” will finally begin!
Summaries.jpn:
新学期しんがっき！ひまりとみつきは

パラダイス学園中等部がくえんちゅうとうぶの2年生ねんせいに進級しんきゅう！

個性こせいあふれる後輩こうはいもできて、学園生活がくえんせいかつはますますにぎやか。

アイプリバースでは、新あたらしいアイプリもぞくぞく登場とうじょう！

見みたことのない新あらたなバズリウムチェンジにみんなで挑戦ちょうせん！

そんな中なか、謎なぞのお姫様ひめさま 「リング・クローバー姫(ひめ)」 と執事しつじのシツムゥが

アイプリコンテスト の開催かいさいを宣言せんげん！

優勝ゆうしょうすると、あこがれの エターナルアイプリ になれると聞きいた

ひまりとみつきはやる気満々きまんまん、気合きあいも十分じゅうぶん！

だけど、リング姫ひめには、

とっても大おおきな『ひみつ』があるみたい……。

おともだちの、そして、ひみつの輪わがどんどん広ひろがってゆく待望(たいぼう)の「リング編(へん)」がいよいよスタート!みなさん、どうぞお楽(たの)しみに!!
Summaries.pt:
Um novo semestre começou! Mitsuki Hoshikawa e Himari Aozora estão agora no 2º ano na Academia Privada Paradise! Com a chegada de novos alunos cheios de personalidades únicas, a vida na escola promete ser mais emocionante do que nunca.

No AiPri Verse, novos AiPris continuam a aparecer! Vamos todos vivenciar uma nova e surpreendente Buzzlume Change (a Jewel Buzzlume Change)!

Mas então, uma misteriosa princesa chamada Ring Clover e seu mordomo, Shitsumu, anunciam que um "Grande Prêmio AiPri" será realizado!

Himari e Mitsuki estão animadas ao saber que, se vencerem, se tornarão as tão esperadas "Eternas AiPris".

Mas... parece que a Princesa Ring está escondendo um grande segredo...

Uma jornada que expandirá os laços de amizade e segredos, a tão esperada "Ring-hen" finalmente começará!

Titles.jpn: ときめき☆あたらしい出会い

Summaries.eng: Himari and Mitsuki advance to the second year of Paradise Private Academy's junior high school. The two Star AiPri members are popular at school, while Tsumugi enjoys school life in the form of her stuffed animal Mugi-chan. Meanwhile, Himari and Mitsuki go to the AiPri Birth to meet a popular AiPri model who is the talk of the AiPri club. They find Julia taking pictures at a photo studio. Himari and Mitsuki quickly become friends with the cheerful Julia. The two ask Julia to perform a live show. However, Julia says that she doesn't feel any excitement at the AiPri live show...
Summaries.jpn: ひまりとみつきは、私立パラダイス学園中等部の二年生に進級。スターアイプリの二人は学園の人気者に、つむぎはぬいぐるみのムギちゃんの姿で学園生活を楽しんでいる。そんな中、ひまりとみつきはアイプリ部で話題になっている人気のアイプリモデルに会いに、アイプリバースへバースイン。パシャリングスタジオで写真を撮っているじゅりあを見つける。明るい性格のじゅりあと早速仲良くなるひまりとみつき。二人はじゅりあにライブをして欲しいとお願い。だけど、じゅりあはアイプリのライブは『ときめき』を感じられないと言って……。

Titles.jpn: じゅりあのひみつ

Summaries.eng: A new member joins the AiPri Club. Her name is Igarashi Julia. It's none other than Julia, the AiPri model. Apparently, she was excited after seeing Himari and Mitsuki's live performance and decided to join the club. However, Julia says she can't perform live until she can sing perfectly. Wanting to know Julia's true feelings, Himari and Mitsuki decide to ask her to teach them how to pasha. As a thank you, they perform live. Mitsuki realizes that Julia really wants to perform live. In fact, there was a song that Julia had always wanted to sing.
Summaries.jpn: アイプリ部に新入部員がやってくる。彼女の名は、五十嵐じゅりあ。なんとアイプリモデルをやっている、あのじゅりあだった。ひまりとみつきのライブを見て心がときめき、入部を決めたらしい。だけど、完璧に歌えるまでライブはやれないと言うじゅりあ。ひまりとみつきはじゅりあの本心が知りたくて、パシャリングを教えてもらうことに。そのお礼にライブを披露する。みつきは、じゅりあが本当はライブをしたいと思っていると気づいていた。実は、じゅりあには「ずっと歌いたい」と思っている歌があったのだ。

Titles.jpn: えるのひみつ

Summaries.eng: Mitsuki picks up a notepad in the library. It was dropped by Julia's roommate, Rokudou Eru. From the notepad, Mitsuki learns that Eru is a popular novelist who writes Aipri novels. Meanwhile, Juria, who has the complete opposite personality to the quiet Eru, lives in the same room but they are always fighting. Juria becomes depressed, thinking that Eru hates her. Hearing this, Mitsuki goes to see Eru. Eru has an Aipri bracelet. She confesses that she loves Aipri but doesn't have the confidence to perform live, so she became a novelist. Mitsuki invites her to join the Aipri club...
Summaries.jpn: みつきは図書室でメモ帳を拾う。落としたのは、じゅりあのルームメイトの六堂えるだった。拾ったメモ帳から、えるがアイプリノベルを書いている人気の小説家だと知るみつき。一方、大人しい性格のえると正反対のじゅりあは、同じ部屋で暮らしているがケンカばかり。えるに嫌われているんじゃ……と落ち込んでしまう。それを聞いたみつきは、えるの元に。えるは、アイプリブレスを持っていた。アイプリは大好きだがライブをする自信はない、だから小説家になったと打ち明ける。そんな彼女を、みつきはアイプリ部に誘い……。

Titles.jpn: 対決！クリーニングマッチ

Summaries.eng: Paradise Academy's annual event, the School Cleaning Match, is being held. It's a cleaning contest between teams. Juria and Elle, who tend to fight, end up forming separate teams to compete against each other. Meanwhile, Himari and Mitsuki, who have each become leaders of different teams, are cleaning together with their palm-sized stuffed animals, "Puri Usa" and "Puri Neko". However, Tsumugi is jealous of Himari and Mitsuki who only show affection for the palm-sized stuffed animals, and runs off somewhere with the chicks that Mr. Matsuoka keeps. Will Himari and Mitsuki be able to find Tsumugi? And what will be the outcome of the cleaning match?
Summaries.jpn: パラダイス学園の恒例行事『スクールクリーニングマッチ』が開催。チーム対抗で行われるお掃除の勝負。ケンカの多いじゅりあとえるは、別のチームになって競い合うことに。一方、それぞれ別のチームのリーダーになったものの、てのひらぬいぐるみの「プリうさ」「プリねこ」と一緒に、仲良く掃除を進めていくひまりとみつき。だが、てのひらぬいぐるみばかり可愛がるひまりとみつきにヤキモチをやいたつむぎは、松岡先生が飼うヒヨコたちを引き連れて、どこかへと行ってしまう。ひまりとみつきは、つむぎを見つけ出すことができるのか？そして、クリーニングマッチの結末は⁉

Titles.jpn: ひみつのアイプリコンテスト

Summaries.eng: Princess Ring's butler, Shitsumu, makes an important announcement. The first Eye Puri Contest will be held! It's a contest to decide the world's best eye puri that will make Princess Ring's heart flutter, sparkle and be thrilled. The winner will be given an eternal outfit. To qualify, the "Ring Gauge" must be filled up. However, Himari and Mitsuki don't have much saved up... This time, the key is to succeed in the "Jewel Buzzrium Change" that Juria and El showed them. Mitsuki and Himari immediately go to ask Juria and El how to change into a Jewel Buzzrium, but...
Summaries.jpn: リング姫の執事シツムゥから重大発表がなされる。第1回アイプリコンテスト開催！それは、リング姫の心をドキドキ、キラキラ、ワクワクさせる世界一のアイプリを決めるコンテスト。優勝した者には、エターナルコーデが与えられるらしい。出場資格を手にするには、『リングゲージ』をいっぱいにしなくてはいけない。しかし、ひまりとみつきはあまり貯まっておらず……。今回は、じゅりあとえるが見せた『ジュエルバズリウムチェンジ』に成功することがカギなのだ。早速みつきとひまりは、じゅりあとえるにジュエルバズリウムチェンジする方法を聞きに行くが……。

Titles.jpn: 雨上がりの二人

Summaries.eng: Ever since seeing Himari and Mitsuki's live performance, Juria has become interested in duos. Eru has also been writing a novel with a duo theme. Encouraged by Mitsuki's words, Eru tries to invite Juria to join a duo. However, Juria has already received an invitation from another Aipri member. Eru is shocked to see Juria looking so happy. Juria encourages Eru, who is feeling down, and calls her out on a rainy day. However, the two get into a huge fight when Eru says she "doesn't like" a song that Juria loves at all...
Summaries.jpn: ひまりとみつきのライブを見て以来、デュオに興味を持ちはじめているじゅりあ。えるもまた、デュオをテーマにした小説を書いていた。みつきの言葉に勇気をもらったえるは、じゅりあをデュオに誘おうとする。だが、じゅりあはすでに別のアイプリから誘いを受けていた。嬉しそうなじゅりあを見たえるはショックを受けてしまう。元気のないえるを励ましたいじゅりあは、雨の降る日に彼女を呼び出す。しかし、じゅりあが大好きな曲を、えるが「全然好きじゃない」と言ってしまったことで、二人は大ゲンカに……。

Titles.jpn: アイプリコンテストかいまく！

Summaries.eng: Himari and Mitsuki are still depressed after failing to perform the Jewel Buzzlume Change. Mitsuki invites Himari to start training. However, worried that Mitsuki is pushing herself too hard, Chii gives Himari some advice. Himari tries to cheer Mitsuki up by organizing a "Mitsuki Love Party" filled with all of Mitsuki's favorite things. Can Mitsuki recover? Meanwhile, the first Aipri Contest begins. Their opponents are the duo "Love Juriel", consisting of Julia and Elle. Who will be the winner?
Summaries.jpn: ジュエルバズリウムチェンジができなかったひまりとみつきは落ち込んだまま。　みつきはひまりを誘い、特訓を開始する。しかし、がんばりすぎなみつきを心配したチィは、ひまりにアドバイスを送る。ひまりは、みつきの大好きなものばかりを集めた『みつきちゃん大好きパーティー』をひらいて元気づけようとする。みつきは立ち直ることが出来るのか。そんな中、はじまる第１回アイプリコンテスト。相手は、じゅりあとえるのデュオ『ラブジュリエル』。優勝するのは果たしてどっちだ⁉

Titles.jpn: リング姫、登場

Summaries.eng: Himari and Mitsuki, winners of the first AiPri contest, will perform a debut live show in front of Princess Ring. Unable to hide their nervousness, the two join up with Julia and Elle and finally head to the palace where Princess Ring is. However, only those who are recognized by the princess at this live show will be able to meet Princess Ring. The Love Juliet duo perform a live show with excitement at full throttle. Poppin' Dreamin' also performs a dignified live show worthy of the name Star AiPri. After the two groups put on a fantastic live show, Princess Ring Clover finally appears before them...
Summaries.jpn: 第１回アイプリコンテストで優勝したひまりとみつきは、リング姫の前でお披露目ライブをすることに。緊張を隠せない二人は、じゅりあ・えると合流し、いよいよリング姫のいる宮殿に向かう。しかしリング姫に会えるのは、このライブで姫に認められた者だけ。ときめき全開でライブをするラブジュリエルの二人。ポッピンドリーミンもスターアイプリの名にふさわしい堂々としたライブを披露する。素晴らしいライブを見せた二組の前に、ついにリング・クローバー姫が姿をあらわしたのだが……。

Titles.jpn: 噂の転校生

Summaries.eng: A certain Aipri is very popular in Aipriverse right now. Apparently he is produced by a very talented producer, but he hasn't had any live shows recently. Meanwhile, Nanaura Subaru transfers to Paradise Academy, class 1A. However, because of his blunt and silent attitude, everyone around him is scared of him. Hiiro, who was walking in a hurry down the hallway, bumps into Subaru. Hiiro is scared, but when Subaru picks up something he's lost, he is surprised. However, Hinata sees what is happening. Hinata thinks that Subaru is scaring her sister, so she challenges him to a soccer match, but...
Summaries.jpn: 第１回アイプリコンテストで優勝したひまりとみつきは、リング姫の前でお披露目ライブをすることに。緊張を隠せない二人は、じゅりあ・えると合流し、いよいよリング姫のいる宮殿に向かう。しかしリング姫に会えるのは、このライブで姫に認められた者だけ。ときめき全開でライブをするラブジュリエルの二人。ポッピンドリーミンもスターアイプリの名にふさわしい堂々としたライブを披露する。素晴らしいライブを見せた二組の前に、ついにリング・クローバー姫が姿をあらわしたのだが……。

Titles.jpn: たったひとつの秘密

Summaries.eng: A famous singing teacher from overseas said that he wanted to produce Mitsuki. Mitsuki wants to take on the challenge, but is worried about leaving Himari behind. Himari is also sad to see Mitsuki go, but wants to support her friend's dream. Since then, Himari has started to work hard to be able to do everything on her own so that Mitsuki won't worry. After listening to Subaru and Wako's talk, Mitsuki has started to become conscious of her "new self." Will Mitsuki and Himari be separated like this?
Summaries.jpn: 海外の有名な歌の先生が、みつきをプロデュースしたいと言ってきた。チャレンジしたい気持ちがありながらも、ひまりを置いていくことが心配なみつき。ひまりもみつきが行くのは寂しいが、おともだちの夢は応援してあげたい、と思っている。それ以来、ひまりはみつきが心配しないよう、ひとりでなんでもできるように頑張り始める。みつきは、すばるやわこ先生の話を聞き、『新しい自分』を意識し始めていた。みつきとひまり、ふたりはこのまま離れ離れになってしまうのか……。

Titles.jpn: おとめのプロデュース

Summaries.eng: Subaru has started singing again as an AiPri member. He is practicing alone, but the repertoire is not one that producer OtoP thought up, but something he came up with herself. Meanwhile, a transfer student, Nanaura Otome, comes to Himari and Mitsuki's class. She produces Paradise Academy to make school life more enjoyable. She also knows a lot about AiPri. Her true identity is Subaru's producer, OtoP. Himari and Mitsuki are surprised. However, when Subaru finds Otome, he suddenly runs away for some reason...
Summaries.jpn: アイプリとして、再び歌を歌い始めたすばる。ひとりレッスンに励んでいるが、それはプロデューサーのおとPが考えたものではなく、自分で考えたメニューだった。そんな中、ひまりとみつきのクラスに転校生・七浦おとめがやってきた。彼女は学園生活がもっと楽しくなるよう、パラダイス学園をプロデュースしていく。そして、アイプリにもやたらと詳しい彼女。その正体はなんと、すばるのプロデューサー『おとP』だった。驚くひまりとみつき。しかし、おとめを見つけたすばるは、なぜか突然逃げ出して……。

Titles.jpn: とべ！ジャンピングロケット

Summaries.eng: The second Ai-Pri Contest is announced. Himari, who has not yet been able to change into Space Buzzrium, is full of enthusiasm. Meanwhile, Otome tells Subaru that she does not need to enter the contest. Subaru tells her clearly that he wants to graduate from Otome's production. However, Otome insists that "absolutely not" and runs away without listening to what he has to say. Mitsuki, who gives Subaru advice, finds out that Otome and Subaru are from Ai-Pri School. Apparently, Otome was taking singing lessons at the time, but she had a "secret."
Summaries.jpn: 第２回アイプリコンテストの開催が発表される。まだスペースバズリウムチェンジができていないひまりは、やる気満々。一方、おとめはすばるにコンテストには出なくてもよいと言う。そんな彼女に、すばるはハッキリと告げる。おとめのプロデュースを卒業したい、と。だが、おとめは「絶対にダメ」と言い張り、話も聞かずに逃げ出してしまう。すばるの相談に乗ったみつきは、おとめとすばるがアイプリスクールの出身だと知る。当時のおとめは歌のレッスンを受けていたそうだが、彼女にはある“ひみつ”があった。

Titles.eng: My Melody and Kuromi Are Here
Titles.jpn: マイメロディとくるみがやってきた

Summaries.eng: Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi meet My Melody at the AiPriverse. The three become friends and make a guest appearance on the "AiPri♪My Melody Channel" broadcast. The event is to give advice to the My Melody friends on their troubles. Then, Kuromi appears! Kuromi answers the My Melody friends' troubles by saying, "Just be like me!" But how can we become like Kuromi? When asked, Kuromi tries to teach Himari and the other AiPri how to "be like Kuromi"...
Summaries.jpn: ひまり、みつき、つむぎの三人は、アイプリバースでマイメロディと出会う。仲良くなった三人は、『アイプリ♪マイメロディチャンネル』の配信にゲスト出演。それは、プリトモのお悩み相談に乗るというもの。すると、そこにクロミも登場！プリトモのお悩みに「アタイみたいになればいい！」と答えるクロミ。でも、クロミちゃんみたいになるにはどうしたらいいの？そう聞かれたクロミは、ひまりたちアイプリに「クロミみたいになる」方法を伝授しようと……。

Titles.jpn: おともだちのえがお

Summaries.eng: When Jumpin' Rocket decides to enter the second Aipri Contest, Shitsumu announces that they will be eligible to enter by the end of the day. Unlike Mitsuki, Himari is not yet able to change into a Space Buzzrium and feels anxious. At that time, Umi, a first-year elementary school student and classmate Nagisa's younger sister, comes to class 2A. Umi says she is a big fan of Aipri Himari. However, she gets into a fight with Nagisa and runs out of the classroom. When Himari finds out that tomorrow is Umi's "day to work hard at the hospital," she chases after her as the deadline for the contest approaches...
Summaries.jpn: ジャンピンロケットが第２回アイプリコンテストの出場を決めた時、シツムゥから出場資格を得られるのは本日中との発表がなされる。みつきと違い、まだスペースバズリウムチェンジができていないひまりは焦りを感じる。そんな時、２年A組に、クラスメイトのなぎさの妹・初等部一年生のうみがやって来る。アイプリひまりの大ファンだと言ううみ。しかし、なぎさとケンカして、教室を飛び出してしまう。うみが「明日、病院でがんばる日」だと知ったひまりは、コンテストの締切が迫る中、うみを探しに追いかけていき……。

Titles.jpn: イム大集合!

Summaries.eng: The final exams are over at Paradise Academy, and summer vacation is just around the corner. Mitsuki is writing a letter to someone. Himari wants to perform a live show, but Aipriverse is currently under maintenance. At Aipriverse, Aimu and the others are making a big fuss, saying that a ghost has appeared. As everyone tries to find out the true identity of the ghost, Aimu and the others end up becoming engrossed in Aipri's live show. However, in the midst of all this, the true identity of the ghost is finally revealed...
Summaries.jpn: 期末テストも終わり、夏休み目前のパラダイス学園。みつきは、誰かにお手紙を書いている。ライブをしたいひまりだが、今はアイプリバースのメンテナンス中。アイプリバースでは、アイムゥたちが「おばけが出た」と大騒ぎしていた。みんなでおばけの正体を調べるうちに、いつの間にかアイプリのライブに夢中になってしまうアイムゥたち。しかしそんな中、おばけの正体が、ついに明らかになって……。

Titles.jpn: 第２回アイプリコンテスト

Summaries.eng: Finally, the 2nd Aipri Contest was held. Even before the live show, Otome is distributing Jumpin Rocket with Subaru to enliven the Pritomo and others. And finally, the contest begins. Both Mitsuki and Jumpin Rocket showed great performances. The one who wins is the one who enlivens more Pritomo. Which hand will win the championship...!?
Summaries.jpn: ついに第２回アイプリコンテストが開催。おとめはライブの前から、すばるとともにジャンピンロケットの配信をして、プリトモたちを盛り上げている。そして、いよいよコンテストがスタート。みつきとジャンピンロケットは、二組とも素晴らしいパフォーマンスを見せた。勝つのは、より多くのプリトモを盛り上げたほう。果たして、優勝はどちらの手に……⁉

Titles.eng: Mitsuki and the Start of Summer
Titles.jpn: みつきと夏のはじまり

Summaries.eng: The debut live performance of Eternal Space Coord is held. Subaru and Otome of Jumpin' Rocket show off a dazzling performance. The theme of the 3rd Aipri Contest is announced as "Animal Buzzlume Change". After "excitement" and "longing", what emotion will be the key next? Researching Buzzlume Change, training Aipri, a summer vacation... Chii proposes a summer training camp for the Aipri club to do it all.
Summaries.jpn: エターナルスペースコーデのお披露目ライブが行われる。キラキラ輝くパフォーマンスを見せるジャンピンロケットのすばるとおとめ。そして第３回アイプリコンテストのテーマは『アニマルバズリウムチェンジ』と発表される。「ときめき」「あこがれ」と来て、次はどんな思いが鍵になるのか。バズリウムチェンジの研究、アイプリの特訓、夏のバカンス……その全部をやってしまおうと、チィはアイプリ部の夏合宿を提案する。

Titles.eng: Would You Like Delichiious Shaved Ice?
Titles.jpn: おいチィかき氷はいかが？

Summaries.eng: During the summer vacation, the "Aipri training camp" of the Aipri club has started. Chii runs a shaved ice shop in the sea with Vivi. Vivi is a first-year junior high school student who yearns for Ipri. Himari and the others are all playing on the beach. Then Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin appeared from the sea! He temporarily returned home from studying abroad to be a special coach for the training camp. On the other hand, Vivi helped the shaved ice shop and said, "I don't like myself, so I want to be Chii-chan." In the meantime, Chii, who worked too hard on the work of the student council and the work of the shaved ice shop, collapsed...
Summaries.jpn: 夏休み、アイプリ部の『アイプリ合宿』がスタート。チィは、ビビと一緒に海でかき氷屋をやっている。ビビはアイプリにあこがれる中等部一年生だ。ひまりたちは、みんな砂浜で遊んでいる。すると海からサクラ、タマキ、アイリ、リンリンがあらわれた！合宿の特別コーチをするため、海外留学から一時帰国してくれたのだ。一方のビビはかき氷屋を手伝いながら、「自分が好きじゃないから、チィちゃんになりたい」という思いを伝えていた。そんな中、生徒会のお仕事とかき氷屋のお仕事をがんばりすぎたチィは倒れてしまい……。

Titles.jpn: つむぎとサマーフェス

Summaries.eng: During the summer vacation "AiPri Training Camp," Sakura and the others are conducting rigorous training. Tsumugi watches Himari and the others as they work hard. During the Aipri Birthday, energy is returning to Tsumugi's Aipri Brace. Upon learning this, Himari invites them to do a live performance right away, but Tsumugi says she wants to do a special live performance. In order to revive Secret Friends ∞, a summer festival "Aipri the Summer" is being held, produced by Oto-P!
Summaries.jpn: 夏休みの『アイプリ合宿』では、サクラたちによる厳しい特訓が繰り広げられていた。一生懸命がんばるひまりたちを、じっと見ているつむぎ。アイプリバースでは、つむぎのアイプリブレスにエナジーが戻ってきていた。それを知ったひまりは、今すぐライブをしようと誘うが、つむぎはスペシャルなライブがしたいと言う。シークレットフレンズ∞を復活させるため、おとPプロデュースによるサマーフェス『アイプリ・ザ・サマー』が開かれることに！

Titles.jpn: ビビはチィの一番弟子

Summaries.eng: Vivi, who has become Chii's number one pupil, joins the AiPri club. Although she doesn't have an AiPri bracelet yet, Vivi desperately tries to keep up with the intensive training at the AiPri training camp. However, she pushes herself until she is completely exhausted and is scolded by Chii. Just as Vivi is feeling down, her advisor, Sarashina-sensei, appears and gives her an AiPri bracelet. Overjoyed, Vivi joins the AiPri-birth. Her registration as an AiPri is complete, and it's finally time for the live performance. However, when it's her turn to perform, Vivi doesn't appear on stage...
Summaries.jpn: チィの一番弟子になったビビは、アイプリ部に入部。まだアイプリブレスを持っていないが、アイプリ合宿の特訓に必死についていくビビ。しかしヘロヘロになるまでやってしまい、チィに叱られてしまう。落ち込むビビの前に顧問の更科先生が現れ、アイプリブレスをくれた。大喜びのビビは、アイプリバースへ。アイプリとしての登録も完了し、いよいよライブに。しかし、出番になってもビビはステージに現れず……。

Titles.jpn: ガチバトル！ビビVSちぃ

Summaries.eng: Vivi, who made a shocking debut, is being talked about among the PriTomos members as a possible winner of the 3rd Aipri Grand Prix. However, Chii is cold towards Vivi. In fact, she has been feeling anxious about Vivi, who achieved the Buzzlume Change at her debut live show. Sakura tells Chii, "There's something you're missing right now." Meanwhile, Vivi, wanting to be recognized by Chii, challenges Chii to a showdown. What will be the outcome of this showdown between master and disciple?
Summaries.jpn: 衝撃的なデビューを果たしたビビは、第３回アイプリグランプリの優勝候補と、プリトモたちの間で話題になっている。だが、そんなビビに、チィは素っ気ない態度。実はデビューライブでバズリウムチェンジを達成したビビに、あせりを感じていたのだ。サクラから「今、君には欠けているものがある」と言われるチィ。そんな中、チィにみとめてもらいたいビビは、チィに対決を挑む。チィとビビ、師弟対決の行方は⁉

Titles.jpn: ギラギラの一番星

Summaries.eng: It's finally the final day of the AiPri training camp. With the 3rd AiPri Contest fast approaching, Juria is struggling with her summer homework. Himari and the others are trying out a live performance to qualify for the 3rd AiPri Contest. Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi from Secret Friends ∞ successfully complete the Animal Buzzlume Change and secure their place in the contest. Chii tries with ease, but unfortunately fails to change into Buzzlume. Chii has lost sight of who she is...
Summaries.jpn: アイプリ合宿も、とうとう最終日。第３回アイプリコンテストが目前にせまる中、じゅりあは夏休みの宿題に大苦戦。ひまりたちは、第３回アイプリコンテスト出場をかけて、ライブに挑戦する。シークレットフレンズ∞のひまり、みつき、つむぎは見事アニマルバズリウムチェンジを達成し、コンテスト出場を決める。チィは余裕を持って挑むが、なんとバズリウムチェンジ失敗。自分らしさを見失ってしまったチィは……。

Titles.jpn: ミツキと秘密の誕生日

Summaries.eng: The second semester has begun. Mitsuki's birthday is coming up soon. Himari is secretly planning a surprise birthday party for Mitsuki. Himari has heard from Yakumo that Mitsuki has treasured a ring since she was little. Together with the members of the Ai-Pri Club, she begins to prepare for the birthday party. Will the surprise birthday party be a success?
Summaries.jpn: ２学期がはじまった。もうすぐみつきの誕生日。ひまりはみつきにひみつで、なにやら動き出す。みつきの、ひみつのサプライズお誕生日会をひらこうとしていたのだ。八雲から、みつきは小さいころから『指輪』を宝物にしている、と聞いたひまり。アイプリ部のみんなと協力して、お誕生会の準備を進めていく。はたして、サプライズお誕生会は成功するのだろうか⁉

Titles.jpn: 涙のアイプリコンテスト

Summaries.eng: The third AiPri Contest has finally begun. Two groups are competing: Secret Friends ∞ and Vivi & Chii. Secret Friends ∞ have achieved the Animal Bazurium Change. However, Himari and Mitsuki can barely keep up with Tsumugi, who is showing off an incredible performance unlike anything they've ever seen before. And Vivi & Chii, whose Pritomo members put on a rousing live performance, is the one to take home the crown of victory...?!
Summaries.jpn: いよいよはじまった第３回アイプリコンテスト。出場するのはシークレットフレンズ∞とビビアンチィの二組。シークレットフレンズ∞は、アニマルバズリウムチェンジを達成。しかし、今までにないすごいパフォーマンスを見せるつむぎに、ついていくのがやっとのひまりとみつき。そして、プリトモたちが大盛り上がりのライブを見せたビビアンチィ。優勝の栄冠は一体どちらの手に……⁉

Titles.jpn: はじめてのステージ

Summaries.eng: With Himari and the rest of the AiPri Princess Club in the spotlight, Vivi and Chii takes on the challenge of their debut live show. After achieving the Animal Buzzrium Change, the two give a performance that is full of "true self" and confidence. However, the debut live show doesn't end there. Ring Princess, moved by their performance, says she will "give you a reward"...!?
Summaries.jpn: ひまりたちアイプリ部も大注目の中、お披露目ライブに挑むビビアンチィ。アニマルバズリウムチェンジを達成し、二人は「自分らしさ」と自信に満ちあふれたライブを見せた。だが、お披露目ライブはそれで終わらなかった。なんと二人のライブに感動したリング姫が、「褒美を取らす」と言い…！？

Titles.jpn: プリンセスのきせき

Summaries.eng: The school principal and Nonose-san visit the Aipri Club. They tell them about an Aipri contest that was held only once in the past. In that contest, one Aipri won by successfully performing five Buzzrium Changes, which was called the "Princess's Miracle." However, it is unknown who the winning Aipri was. Himari and the others look at the records of their previous live performances to try to get to the bottom of the mystery.
Summaries.jpn: 学園長先生と野乃瀬さんがアイプリ部をたずねてきた。二人は、昔たった一度だけ開かれたアイプリコンテストのことを教えてくれる。そのコンテストでは、あるひとりのアイプリが五つのバズリウムチェンジを成功させて優勝、それは『プリンセスの奇跡』と呼ばれた。だが優勝したアイプリが誰なのかはわからない。ひまりたちは、これまでのライブの記録を見て、その謎に迫ろうとする。

Titles.jpn: ひみつのテスト

Summaries.eng: Having missed out on the win in the last AiPri Contest and feeling frustrated, Tsumugi is currently training hard for the next contest. "I want to be a flower that sparkles more, that gives courage," she says, and so she goes alone to meet Princess Ring. Tsumugi asks what she should do to give a live performance that is as sparkling and cute as Princess Ring. Princess Ring decides to conduct a secret test to see if Tsumugi's feelings are genuine. Dressed in her school uniform, Tsumugi arrives at Paradise Academy, an Ai-Priverse school created by Princess Ring. What exactly is the content of the test...?
Summaries.jpn: 前回のアイプリコンテストで優勝を逃し、「くやしい」という気持ちを経験したつむぎは、次のコンテストに向けて特訓をしている。「もっとキラキラ、勇気を与える、お花になりたい」と言うつむぎは一人、リング姫に会いに行く。リング姫のようなキラキラとかわいいライブをするには、どうすればよいか尋ねるつむぎ。リング姫はつむぎの気持ちが本気かどうか試すため、ひみつのテストを行うことに。制服を着た姿で、リング姫が作ったアイプリバースのパラダイス学園にやってくるつむぎ。果たして、テストの内容とは……？

Titles.jpn: ほんとうのキモチ

Summaries.eng: Chii is investigating the secret of Princess Ring. She hasn't figured anything out yet, but Mitsuki says she remembers something. When she was little, the first Aipri Princess Mitsuki dreamed of was Princess Ring. Thinking this, Mitsuki searches for a memorable picture drawn by Himari. However, when she finds it, she tears it up. Meanwhile, Princess Ring gives the Aipri Princesses a "secret test." Mitsuki is unable to concentrate, worried about the picture she tore. While Himari and the others are taking their respective tests, Mitsuki meets her younger self...
Summaries.jpn: リング姫のひみつについて、調査をしているチィ。まだなにもつかめていなかったが、みつきは思い出したことがあると言う。小さい頃、みつきが初めてあこがれたアイプリ、それがリング姫かもしれない。そう思い、ひまりが描いた思い出の絵を探すみつき。だが、見つけた拍子に破ってしまう。そんな中、リング姫からアイプリたちに向けて、『ひみつのテスト』が行われることに　破った絵のことが気になり、集中できないみつき。ひまりたちがそれぞれのテストを受けている中、みつきは小さい頃の自分に出会って……。

Titles.jpn: うらないとひみつの夢

Summaries.eng: Himari is obsessed with fortune telling. Then her classmate, Ichika Kisaragi, calls out to her. Ichika is also a big fan of fortune telling. She says she has something she wants to ask Mitsuki. Apparently, her fortune told her that Yakumo is her "soulmate." After hearing Yakumo's dream of attending Dream Star Academy after graduation, Ichika declares that she will also go to the same school. However, her childhood friend, Nagisa, is worried about Ichika, who is not good at studying. Nagisa has always wanted to be with her, so she consults Mitsuki and Himari, but...
Summaries.jpn: アイプリグラムの『アイプリスマホ占い』にハマっているひまり。すると、クラスメイトの如月いちかが声をかけてくる。いちかも大の占い好きなのだ。そんな彼女は、みつきに聞きたいことがあると言う。なんと、占いで八雲が『運命の人』と出たらしい。卒業したら『ドリームスター学園』に進学したいという八雲の夢を聞いたいちかは、自分も同じ学校に行くと宣言。だが幼なじみのなぎさは、勉強が苦手ないちかが心配。ずっと一緒にいたいと思っていたなぎさは、みつきとひまりに相談するのだが……。

Titles.eng: Princess Ring Clover and the Secret Halloween
Titles.jpn: リング姫とひみつのハロウィン

Summaries.eng: Juria and Elle become Halloween executive committee members and plan a fun party. Tsumugi invites Princess Ring to the Halloween party being held at Paradise Academy. When she thinks it sounds fun, Princess Ring turns into a Pricon stuffed animal and heads to Paradise Academy. Princess Ring goes around the Halloween party as Pricon, exchanging sweets and dressing up as ghosts. Meanwhile, she sees Juria and El, who are also on the executive committee, fighting...
Summaries.jpn: じゅりあとえるはハロウィンの実行委員になり、楽しいパーティーを企画。つむぎはパラダイス学園で開かれるハロウィンパーティーにリング姫を誘う。「楽しそう」と思ったとき、リング姫はプリこーんのぬいぐるみとなり、パラダイス学園へ。おかし交換やお化けの仮装など、プリこーんとしてハロウィンパーティーを見て回るリング姫。そんな中、実行委員だったじゅりあとえるがケンカしているのを見てしまい……。

Titles.jpn: つむぎとリング

Summaries.eng: Tsumugi visits Princess Ring. Princess Ring says there is still a lot she doesn't know. Tsumugi tells her she will teach her many things and they make a promise to meet the next day at lunchtime. In order to learn more, Tsumugi goes to the Paradise Academy library disguised as Mugi-chan. Tsumugi is excited to teach Princess Ring even more. However, she becomes so engrossed in the book that she forgets her promise to Princess Ring...
Summaries.jpn: つむぎは、リング姫の元を訪れる。まだまだ知らないことがたくさんあると言うリング姫。つむぎはそんな彼女に「いろんなことを教えてあげる」と言い、次の日のお昼に会う約束をした。つむぎはもっといろんなことを勉強するため、ムギちゃんの姿でパラダイス学園の図書室に行く。リング姫にもっとたくさんのことを教えてあげたいと張り切るつむぎ。しかし本に夢中になるあまり、リング姫との約束を忘れてしまい……。

Titles.jpn: ひとりぼっちのプリンセス

Summaries.eng: Princess Ring is worried because she has not been able to make up with Tsumugi. Tsumugi, who is also worried, visits Chii. After hearing about how to make up, Tsumugi heads out. Meanwhile, Princess Ring has not filled up her ring gauge and cannot participate in the 4th AiPri Contest. The reason for this is that Princess Ring has no one to whom she wants to convey her feelings, in other words, no friends. Tsumugi comes to Princess Ring with many presents. However, Princess Ring sends Tsumugi home without accepting any. Princess Ring is alone in the secret garden when Mitsuki comes to her...
Summaries.jpn: つむぎと仲直りできず、思い悩むリング姫。同じように悩むつむぎは、チィの元を訪れていた。仲直りの方法を聞いたつむぎは出かけていく。一方、リング姫はリングゲージが貯まらず、第４回アイプリコンテストには出場できない。その原因は、リング姫に「思いを届けたい相手」、つまり「おともだち」がいないからだった。そんなリング姫の元に、たくさんのプレゼントを持ってやってきたつむぎ。しかしリング姫は受け取ることなく、つむぎを帰らせてしまう。一人でひみつの庭にいるリング姫の元に、みつきがやってきて……。

Titles.jpn: 花咲くアイプリコンテスト

Summaries.eng: The 4th AiPri Contest is about to begin. The participants are the duo Poppin' Dreamin' who consist of Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, and Luminous Flora who consist of Tsumugi Suzukaze and Ring Clover. Tsumugi declares, "We're friends, but this time we're rivals."
Summaries.jpn: いよいよ第４回アイプリコンテストが開幕。出場するのは、ひまりとみつきのデュオ・ポッピンドリーミンと、リング姫とつむぎのデュオ。つむぎは、ひまりとみつきに「おともだちだけど今回はライバル」と言い放つ。その後、つむぎはリング姫とのデュオに「光り輝く花」という意味の『ルミナスフローラ』と名付ける。そして、たくさんの人が見守る中、いよいよ始まるコンテスト。優勝するのは、果たしてどちらのデュオなのか⁉

Titles.jpn: わたしたちの勇気

Summaries.eng: It's time for the 4th Aipri Contest debut live performance. The first live performance was by Luminous Flora. After witnessing their amazing performance, Mitsuki and Himari make a decision. The two of them decide to withdraw from the debut live performance. What are Mitsuki and Himari thinking...?
Summaries.jpn: 第４回アイプリコンテストのお披露目ライブの日。パラダイス学園のみんなに応援され、ひまりもみつきもやる気じゅうぶん　最初のライブは、ルミナスフローラから。リング姫とつむぎは、誰もが見惚れるような圧巻のライブを披露する。そのすごさを目の当たりにしたみつきとひまりは、ある決意をする。二人はなんと、お披露目ライブを辞退すると言い出したのだ。みつきとひまりの思いとは……？

Titles.jpn: 帰ってきたカルテットスター

Summaries.eng: Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin have returned to Paradise Academy! However, something seems strange. Everyone exudes a sharp, stern aura. Tsumugi says that she senses the scent of a "Dark Quartet Star" among the four Quartet Stars. Mitsuki tries to find out the truth about what happened to Sakura and the others. Have Sakura and the other four really become Dark Quartet Stars...?
Summaries.jpn: パラダイス学園にサクラ、タマキ、アイリ、リンリンの四人が帰ってきた！しかし、どこか様子がおかしい。みんな、鋭く厳しい雰囲気を醸し出している。つむぎは言う。カルテットスターの四人に「ダークカルテットスター」の匂いを感じると。サクラたちになにがあったのか、真相を確かめようとするみつき。本当にサクラたち四人は、ダークカルテットスターになってしまったのだろうか……？

Titles.jpn: ひまりのママのひみつ

Summaries.eng: It's the day of the three-way meeting to discuss their future paths. While Mitsuki's dream is to study abroad and study singing, Himari's dreams are still vague. Then, Himari's mother reveals her feelings to her.
Summaries.jpn: 今日は進路を相談する三者面談の日。ひまりの将来の夢は、『アイプリをがんばって、おともだちを笑顔にする』こと。『留学して歌の勉強をする』というみつきの夢に対して、ひまりの夢はまだぼんやりとしている。いつかみつきとのお別れが来ることをさびしく思っているひまり。そんなひまりに、ママは今までひみつにしていた自分の気持ちを明かす。その言葉を聞いたひまりは、張り切ってみつきとのライブに臨むのだった。

Titles.jpn: 指輪のひみつ

Summaries.eng: On the day of their parent-teacher conference, Sakura told Mitsuki, "If you have the desire to spread your wings, it's better to do it as soon as possible." Mitsuki is wondering if it would be better to speed up her study abroad. Christmas is just around the corner. Everyone at Paradise Academy seems to be having fun preparing for Christmas. Meanwhile, Mitsuki is remembering something. She once met an AiPri around Christmas time. Mitsuki exchanged star-shaped candy and a winged ring with that AiPri. That AiPri's name was Ring Clover. But even now, she knows her true identity well...
Summaries.jpn: 三者面談の日、サクラから「羽ばたきたい気持ちがあるのなら、できるだけ早いほうがいい」と言われていたみつき。留学を早めたほうが良いのか悩んでいる。そして、もうすぐクリスマス。パラダイス学園はその準備で、みんな楽しそう。そんな中、みつきは思い出していた。昔、クリスマスの頃に一人のアイプリと出会っていたことを。みつきはそのアイプリと、星の形をしたキャンディと羽のついた指輪を交換した。そのアイプリの名前はリング・クローバー。その正体は、今もよく知る“あの人”で……。

Titles.jpn: 楽しいウィンターフェスティバル！

Summaries.eng: Today we have a special project, bringing you a "Christmas Winter Festival" with everyone from Aipri! Following live performances by Jumpin' Rocket, Quartet Star, and Vivi & Chii, Julia, Elle, Subaru, and Mitsuki also performed solo live shows. As the excitement reached its climax, Princess Ring also appeared. It seemed she was envious of the fun-looking event. With Princess Ring joining in, the Winter Festival moved into the second half. The excitement of the Pritomo members is rising even more!
Summaries.jpn: 今日は特別企画、アイプリのみんなで『クリスマス・ウィンターフェス』をお届け！ジャンピンロケット、カルテットスター、ビビアンチィのライブにつづいて、じゅりあ、える、すばる、みつきのソロライブも披露。最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる中、そこにリング姫も登場。楽しそうなイベントがうらやましかったようだ。そんなリング姫も加わり、ウィンターフェスは後半戦へ。プリトモたちの熱は、さらに高まっていく！

Titles.jpn: みつきちゃんがいっぱい

Summaries.eng: Mitsuki is asked by a famous song producer to send a promotional video. Upon hearing this, Himari declares that she will be the director and make the promotional video. With the help of Tsumugi, Hinata, Yakumo, and Hiiro, they begin filming. Under the cold sky, they somehow manage to finish filming. They were supposed to gather everyone together for a unveiling party, but Himari made a mistake in the controls and the filmed footage was lost. They try to re-shoot it, but Mitsuki ends up with a fever... What will Himari do?
Summaries.jpn: 有名な歌のプロデューサーから、プロモーションビデオを送って欲しいと頼まれたみつき。それを聞いたひまりは、自分が監督になりプロモーションビデオを作ると宣言。つむぎ、ひなた、八雲、ひいろにも協力してもらい、いざ撮影スタート。寒空の下、なんとか撮影は終了する。みんなを集めてお披露目会をするはずが、ひまりが操作を間違ってしまい、撮影した映像は消えてしまった。撮り直そうとするも、みつきが熱を出してしまい……。どうする、ひまり⁉

Titles.jpn: レジェンド・ストーリー!!!!

Summaries.eng: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Sakura and the others are excited to enter and uncover the secrets of the Aipriverse. Airi has decided that she needs a new song to put her all on the line for the contest. Airi boasts that she will have the new song completed by the next live performance. She interviews the Aipri and the others and expands on the image of the new song. Later, while talking with Mitsuki, Airi reaffirms her dream of "not just performing a live performance, but creating the live performance itself." However, she is troubled by the pressure of not being able to write a new song yet. Will Quartet Star be able to complete their new song?
Summaries.jpn: もうすぐ第５回アイプリコンテスト。出場して、アイプリバースのひみつも解き明かすと意気込むサクラたち。アイリは、コンテストに向けて勝負をかける新曲が必要だと考えていた。次のライブまでに新曲を完成させると豪語するアイリ。アイプリたちに取材をし、新曲のイメージを膨らませていく。その後、みつきと話す中で「ライブをするだけではなく、ライブそのものも作ってみたい」という自身の夢を再認識するアイリ。しかし、未だ新曲が出来ないプレッシャーに悩んでいた。果たして、カルテットスターの新曲は完成するのだろうか？

Titles.jpn: 想い伝わるアイプリコンテスト

Summaries.eng: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Mitsuki has decided to tell Himari that after the contest she will be studying abroad in the spring, and that she only has three more months to be with her. And finally, the day of the contest arrives. Poppin' Dreamin' and Quartet Star will be on stage. Mitsuki tells Himari that there is something she wants to talk to her about after the contest is over. Himari also asks Mitsuki for a date on Valentine's Day. Even though she senses that Mitsuki will soon be gone, Himari takes on the challenge of the contest.
Summaries.jpn: もうすぐ第５回アイプリコンテスト。みつきは、ひまりに「コンテストが終わったら春から留学、ひまりと一緒にいられるのは、あと３ヶ月」だと、話そうと決意していた。そして、いよいよコンテスト当日。ステージに立つのは、ポッピンドリーミンとカルテットスター。みつきは、コンテストが終わったら話したいことがあると、ひまりに言う。ひまりも、バレンタインデーに、みつきとデートがしたいとお願い。もうすぐみつきがいなくなると感じながらも、ひまりはコンテストに挑む。

Titles.jpn: 大好きだから

Summaries.eng: Three days have passed since the 5th Aipri Contest. Himari has vacated her room with Mitsuki and is staying in Juria and Ellu's room. It's lonely and painful to see Mitsuki. Mitsuki becomes worried when Himari disappears from her room. Meanwhile, after receiving "certain words" from teacher Wako, Mitsuki decides to tell Himari that "we'll be saying goodbye in three months." However, Himari doesn't want to hear them and starts running away from Mitsuki...
Summaries.jpn: 第５回アイプリコンテストが終わって３日。ひまりはみつきと同室の部屋を空け、じゅりあとえるの部屋にお泊りしていた。みつきと顔を合わせるのが、さびしくて、つらいのだ。ひまりが部屋からいなくなり、心配するみつき。そんな中、わこ先生から“ある言葉”をもらったみつきは、ひまりに「あと３ヶ月でお別れ」だと、ちゃんと言おうと決意する。しかし、聞きたくないひまりは、みつきから逃げるようになり……。

Titles.jpn: ひみつのバレンタインデー

Summaries.eng: Valentine's Day is approaching, and six groups -Poppin Dreamin, Quartet Star, Vivi & Chii, Jumping Rocket, Love JurieL and Luminous Flora - are announced to be competing in the Final AiPri Contest. Himari and Mitsuki are preparing for their promised date. At that time, the two receive an invitation to a Valentine's Day party from Princess Ring. Princess Ring thanks the six groups of AiPri, saying, "I feel so happy that all the Buzzrium Changes are here." Subaru tells Princess Ring that he has prepared a special live performance for Valentine's Day. Wako-sensei is looking forward to the performance, but...
Summaries.jpn: ポッピンドリーミン、ラブジュリエル、ジャンピンロケット、ビビアンチィ、ルミナスフローラ、カルテットスターの６組が『ファイナル・アイプリコンテスト』に出場すると発表される中、バレンタインデーがやってくる。ひまりとみつきは、約束していたデートの準備。そんな時、リング姫からバレンタインパーティーに招待される二人。６組のアイプリに向かって、リング姫は「全てのバズリウムチェンジが揃って、とても幸せな気分だ」と、お礼を言う。すばるは、バレンタインデーのための特別なライブを用意しているとリング姫に伝えた。そのライブを楽しみに待つ わこ先生だが……。

Titles.jpn: わことリング

Summaries.eng: At the same time that Wako-Sensei collapsed, Princess Ring fell into a deep sleep. At Paradise Academy, Chairman Kindaichi began to speak about Princess Ring. In the past, Princess Ring had attempted five different Buzzlume Changes. Then, on the night of her 15th birthday, she successfully completed the Jewel, Space, Animal, Flower, and Melody Buzzlume Changes, miraculously achieving the "Princess's Miracle." However, at the same time, Princess Ring lost all of her memories. The true identity of Princess Ring was none other than Ms. Wako Sarashina. And in the "Secret Garden," Ms. Wako reunited with Princess Ring, who was herself...
Summaries.jpn: わこ先生が倒れるのと同時に、眠りについてしまったリング姫。パラダイス学園では、リング姫について、金田一理事長が語り始めていた。リング姫は過去、５つのバズリウムチェンジに挑戦。そして１５歳の誕生日の夜、ジュエル、スペース、アニマル、フラワー、メロディ、５つのバズリウムチェンジを達成し、見事『プリンセスの奇跡』を起こした。しかし、それと同時にリング姫はすべての記憶を失ってしまった。そのリング姫の正体こそ、更科わこ先生だったのだ。そして、わこ先生は『ひみつの庭』で、自分自身であるリング姫と再会し……。

Titles.jpn: リング・クローバーのひみつ

Summaries.eng: The two rings, Ring Tiara and Star Wing, become one and show a light. At the end of the light is a book. To rescue Princess Ring, Mitsuki and Himari jump into the light that envelops the book. They arrive at the forest where Mitsuki visited as a child. There, a book bearing the Jewel crest appears. Julia and Elle realize that they need to perform a Jewel Buzzlume Change to open the book, and so they begin their live performance.
Summaries.jpn: リングティアラとスターウィング、二つの指輪が一つになり、光を放つ。光の先には、一冊の本が。リング姫を助け出すため、みつきはひまりと共に、本を包み込む光の中に飛び込む。辿り着いた先は、みつきが幼い頃にやってきた森だった。すると、そこにジュエルの紋章を持つ本が現れる。本を開くには、ジュエルバズリウムチェンジをする必要が――、そう気づいたじゅりあとえるは、ライブを始める。

Titles.jpn: つながるリング

Summaries.eng: Tsumugi performs a live concert to bring back Princess Ring. She sings with all her might to convey her "courage" and "love," and performs a Flower Buzzlume Change. Meanwhile, Mitsuki and Himari are in the secret garden, looking at Princess Ring's memories. When Mitsuki was little, she wanted to be friends with Princess Ring, so she gave her her treasured star-shaped sugar candy. After that, the former Princess Ring successfully performed five Buzzlume Changes. Following Tsumugi, Quartet Star performs a live concert to achieve a Melody Buzzlume Change. They are a great success, and the five crests light up. But Princess Ring does not appear...
Summaries.jpn: リング姫を呼び戻すため、ライブをするつむぎ。「勇気」と「大好き」を届けようと一生懸命歌い、フラワーバズリウムチェンジする。一方、みつきとひまりはひみつの庭で、リング姫の記憶を見ていた。みつきは小さい頃、リング姫とおともだちになりたくて、宝物のお星さまの金平糖をあげた。その後、かつてのリング姫は５つのバズリウムチェンジを成功させたのだ。つむぎに続き、メロディバズリウムチェンジを達成するため、カルテットスターがライブ。見事成功させ、５つの紋章に光が灯った。だがリング姫は姿を現さず……。

Titles.jpn: とびらをひらいて

Summaries.eng: It's been a week since Princess Ring returned to Aipriverse. Life has returned to normal for Mitsuki and the others at Paradise Academy. Mr. Sarashina tells Mitsuki and the others about what happened to Teacher Wako. Mr. Sarashina is trying to restore Princess Ring's memories to Teacher Wako. However, Princess Ring and Teacher Wako end up going their separate ways. After the maintenance on Aipriverse is finished, Mitsuki and the others go to Princess Ring. Princess Ring has prepared the rest of the Valentine's Day feast.
Summaries.jpn: リング姫がアイプリバースに戻ってから一週間。パラダイス学園では、みつきたちにいつもの毎日が戻ってきた。更科先生から、わこ先生に起こったことを聞かされるみつきたち。更科先生は、リング姫の記憶をわこ先生に取り戻そうとしていた。　しかし、リング姫とわこ先生は別々の道を歩んでいくことになったのだった。その後、アイプリバースのメンテナンスが終わり、みつきたちはリング姫の元へ。リング姫がバレンタインの宴の続きを用意してくれていたのだ。

Titles.jpn: ファイナル・アイプリコンテスト開幕

Summaries.eng: The Final AiPri Contest has begun! The six participating groups are Poppin' Dreamin', Love Juliet, Jumpin' Rocket, Vivi & Chii, Luminous Flora, and Quartet Star. The winner will be awarded the title of "Eternal AiPri", an eye puri that will be passed down forever, and a special outfit, the "Eternal AiPri Outfit", that only the person who reaches the top is allowed to wear. The final contest has finally begun!
Summaries.jpn: ファイナル・アイプリコンテスト、開幕！出場するのは、ポッピンドリーミン、ラブジュリエル、ジャンピンロケット、ビビアンチィ、ルミナスフローラ、カルテットスターの６組。優勝者には、永遠に語り継がれるアイプリ『エターナルアイプリ』の称号と、頂点に立った者だけが着ることを許された特別なコーデ、『エターナルアイプリコーデ』が贈られる。最後のコンテストが、いよいよ始まった！
